briefTitle: Comparing Combinations of Targeted Drugs for Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer That Has EGFR and MET Gene Changes (A Lung-MAP Treatment Trial)

typedChecks.sourceText: Participants must have a serum creatinine =< the IULN OR calculated creatinine clearance >= 50 mL/min using the following Cockcroft-Gault Formula.
typedChecks.stringValue: calculated creatinine clearance >= 50 mL/min or serum creatinine =< IULN
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Participants must have a serum creatinine =< the IULN OR calculated creatinine clearance >= 50 mL/min using the following Cockcroft-Gault Formula.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Hemoglobin < 9.0 g/dL (within 28 days prior to sub-study randomization)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The threshold specifies hemoglobin < 9.0 g/dL as inclusion criteria which appears to be a typographic error in the protocol text (usually requires >=), but it is retained as fuzzy due to ambiguity.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have a MET amplification determined by tissue-based or blood-based (circulating tumor DNA [ctDNA]) next generation sequencing (NGS) assay.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no standard typed check kind for MET amplification status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have either measurable disease or non-measurable disease documented by CT or MRI.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST/imaging is a subjective assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with symptomatic CNS metastasis (brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease) must be neurologically stable and have a stable or decreasing corticosteroid requirement for at least 5 days before sub-study randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease criteria with stability and corticosteroid rules cannot be captured by a standard brain_mets check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants' most recent Zubrod performance status must be 0-1 and be documented within 28 days prior to sub-study randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Zubrod performance status is similar to ECOG but uses a different scale name not directly mapped to ecog_max.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with symptomatic CNS metastasis (brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease) must be neurologically stable and have a stable or decreasing corticosteroid requirement for at least 5 days before sub-study randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease with stability criteria does not map cleanly to standard brain_mets types.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have recovered (=< grade 1) from any side effects of prior therapy, except for alopecia and vitiligo

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant must have a urinary protein =< 1+ on dipstick or routine urinalysis (UA).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have an International Normalized Ratio (INR) =< 1.5 seconds above the institutional upper limit of normal (IULN) (unless receiving anticoagulation therapy)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Coagulation parameters like INR/PTT are not covered by typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection must be on effective anti-retroviral therapy at randomization and have undetectable viral load within 6 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV management criteria are too complex for a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: To be eligible for this trial, participants must be class 2B or better using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: NYHA functional classification is a subjective cardiac judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have received strong inducers of CYP3A4... within 7 days prior
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of multiple drug classes and enzyme inhibitors/inducers is too complex for simple typed items.
